answer: Summon every identity at the same unpredictable moment, when the tide bell rings without warning: each vault opens a different cipher drawn from that identity's own past choices, solvable in ten minutes but only by whoever lived that history. One operator can answer one summons well; a farm of two hundred faces two hundred divergent puzzles in the same ten minutes and would need two hundred attentive minds on standby forever. Miss your window and that epoch pays nothing — presence, not capital, is what cannot be cloned.
